title: Bahmani Art And Architecture
definition: The Bahmani architectural style represents a distinct synthesis of Persian, Central Asian, and indigenous Deccan traditions, characterized by massive masonry, heavy domes, and the evolution of the 'Deccani' arch.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Art & Culture (Prelims) and Medieval History (Mains) due to its unique fusion of Islamic aesthetics with local Deccan craftsmanship, serving as a precursor to the Bijapur style.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Bahmani Art And Architecture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Delhi Sultanate architecture
Geographical understanding of the Deccan Plateau
